paras: Cyrtodactylus wayakonei is a species of gecko, a lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is indigenous to southeastern Asia.
The specific name, wayakonei, is in honor of Laotian conservationist Sengdeuane Wayakone.
C. wayakonei is found in northern Laos and in Yunnan Province in southern China.
The preferred natural habitats of C. wayakonei are forest and dry caves, at altitudes of 730–810 m (2,400–2,660 ft).
Medium-sized for its genus, C. wayakonei may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 9 cm (3.5 in).
The mode of reproduction of C. wayakonei is unknown.
